p: An instrument of music brought from Geth.

aloud unto God our strength: It seems that this psalm was appointed for solemn feasts and assemblies of the people to whom for a time these ceremonies were ordained, but now under the gospel are abolished.
new moon: Under this feast he comprehends all other solemn days.
Joseph for a testimony: That is, in Israel for Joseph's family was counted the chief while before, Judah was preferred.
I understood not: God speaks in the person of the people because he was their leader.

pots: If they were never able to give sufficient thanks to God, for this deliverance from corporal bondage, how much more are we indebted to him for our spiritual deliverance from the tyranny of Satan and sin?
answered thee in the secret place: By a strange and wonderful fashion.
Hear: He condemns all assemblies where the people are not attentive to hear God's voice, and to give obedience to the same.
open thy mouth wide: God accuses their incredulity, because they did not open their mouths to receive God's benefits in such abundance as he pours them out.
Oh that my people had hearkened: God by his word calls all, but his secret election appoints who will bear fruit.
against their adversaries: If their sins had not.
should have endured for ever: If the Israelites had not broken covenant with God, he would have given them victory against their enemies.
finest of the wheat: That is, with most fine wheat and abundance of honey.
